name: Avianca LifeMiles Elite

apr.notes: 19.49% to 29.49% when you open your account, based on your creditworthiness. After that, your APR will vary with the market based on the Prime Rate. Penalty APR: None. No minimum interest charge. Late payment fee up to $8. This card does not have a cash advance or ATM access feature. Purchase APR: Prime + 12.74% to Prime + 22.74%. U.S. Prime Rate effective as of December 16, 2025 is 6.75%. Information accurate as of March 9, 2026.

credit_required.notes: Not explicitly stated by issuer. Offers subject to credit approval.

base_rate.description: 1x mile per $1 on all other purchases (doubled to 2x with LifeMiles+ membership)

categories.label: Avianca airlines and LifeMiles purchases (3x base, 6x with LifeMiles+)
Travel and restaurants (2x base, 4x with LifeMiles+)

rewards.redemption_notes: Miles do not expire for as long as you use your card. Complimentary LifeMiles+ Lite membership doubles miles up to 1,000 miles/month. 10% miles back on Star Alliance redemptions, up to 25% discount on Avianca flights, up to 40% more miles on LifeMiles hotels/cars, up to 10% discount on LifeMiles cars.

signup_bonus.description: Earn up to 100,000 miles. 60,000 bonus miles after $4,500 in first 90 days, plus 40,000 more after $25,000 in first 365 days. (Spend breakdown preserved from prior verification — product page states 'Earn up to 100,000 miles' with 'Minimum spend required' but does not display the full tiered breakdown in fetched text.)

benefits.title: Avianca Silver Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Avianca Silver elite status with lounge access, premium seat selection, additional checked bags, and priority boarding. Each year your status will automatically renew if you maintain an active Avianca LifeMiles card.

benefits.title: Complimentary LifeMiles+ Lite Membership
benefits.description: Automatically double your miles up to 1,000 miles per month. Get 10% miles back on Star Alliance flight redemptions, up to 25% redemption discount on Avianca airlines flights, up to 40% more miles on LifeMiles hotels and LifeMiles cars, up to 10% discount on LifeMiles cars.

benefits.title: 10% Miles Back on Star Alliance Redemptions
benefits.description: Get 10% miles back on Star Alliance flight redemptions via LifeMiles+ membership.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fee
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fee on purchases made outside the US.

benefits.description: Miles do not expire for as long as you use your card.
